we selected proteins which were identified in proteomic analyses of three biological UV cross-linked replicates.

digested with 1μg of trypsin (Promega) at 37°C overnight
each treatment was chemically labeled by reductive dimethylation using formaldehyde isotopologues
protein solutions were reduced and alkylated as per
fixed modifications—carbamidomethyl, variable modifications—methionine oxidation
The analysis was performed over 90 min peptide separation
UV-irradiated 3 times (1 min each with 2 mins gap on ice)
placed on ice pack (immediately before cross-linking)
interactome capture using oligo(dT) magnetic beads
The isolated proteins were concentrated using an Amicon Ultra 10 3-kDa device.
